purpose: deterministic offline reference search, not real-time planning
completeness_claim: Every unique request in the declared finite per-event domain is reconstructed and, when construction succeeds, exact-validated exactly once. No claim is made for continuous P3 parameter space.

path_family.family: existing five-knot four-segment C2 quintic-Hermite Frenet P3

target_domain.per_event_gate_side_bounds: exact valid CONTEXT minimum_target and maximum_target reported by the frozen C++ harness
additional_exact_anchors: same-side production d_target values inside the context bounds
same-side complete frozen factor-pool d_target values inside the context bounds
same-side complete frozen factor-pool d_mid values

transition_factor_set.rule: all unique exact (entry_scale, exit_scale) pairs generated by production for that evaluator input

geometry_factor_anchors.purpose: guarantee exact coverage of frozen H3/H4-A/H4-B lateral factors without changing the uniform grid

exact_parity_request_union.rule: union every exact STRICT production request and every exact STRICT request tuple in the complete frozen factor pool before selector top-K, including tuples whose target is outside the harness-reported side interval by exact comparison
exact_parity_request_union.reason: bit-exact boundary production requests and out-of-interval frozen factor requests must reach the same C++ construction/validation path so production and H3/H4-A/H4-B candidate-count and digest/verdict parity are auditable

root_probe_treatment.reason: s_probe and d_probe are generator lineage, not independent direct-P3 spline degrees of freedom after d_mid is fixed
root_probe_treatment.coverage: all production root/probe-derived d_target and d_mid values are exact anchors; frozen factor-pool d_mid values are also exact anchors

request_space: Union of (a) every valid gate/side CONTEXT Cartesian product(target set, same-side d_mid set, production transition-pair set), (b) every exact STRICT production request, and (c) every exact STRICT complete-factor-pool request tuple

deduplication.request_tuple: exact canonical float tuple deduplicated before submission
deduplication.path_digest: reported after exact validation for unique-path accounting only; never used to prune declared request coverage
